---
title: "Quiz template"
---

Starter for a **standalone quiz** artifact. Use this when the quiz is scoped
to a whole part or course rather than a single lesson.

## Files

- `quiz.qmd` — quiz page with collapsible answer callouts
- `metadata.yaml` — machine-readable quiz descriptor

## Placement

Place quiz artifacts in the course they belong to, for example:

```
courses/<slug>/part-1/quiz.qmd
courses/<slug>/quiz.qmd
```

Lesson-embedded quizzes should use
[`templates/lesson/quiz.qmd`](../lesson/quiz.qmd) instead.

## OELS authoring

Quizzes copied from this template inherit the shared Open Engineering
Language Server (OELS) authoring contract. Quiz prose in `quiz.qmd`
(including YAML front matter and any collapsible answer callouts) is
owned by Quarto and is not scanned by OELS. Quiz `metadata.yaml` is
silently ignored by OELS today. See the **OELS authoring integration**
section of [`templates/README.qmd`](../README.qmd) for the full
artifact classification table, portable local stdio/LSP usage,
diagnostics-vs-Quarto guidance, and troubleshooting.
